AGENCY REFERENCE

Clarity & precision

Names: describe the value, use underscores between words and keep the spelling consistent. There is more than one good name.

evidence_boxes = int(input("How many evidence boxes? "))
shelf_spaces = evidence_boxes * 3
print(f"Shelf spaces needed: {shelf_spaces}")

Inputs: ask for the specific information required. input() returns text. Use int() for a whole-number calculation.

Outputs: put f before the opening quote and place a variable inside { }. Include labels and units.

NameError? Check every use of a renamed variable. ValueError? Enter digits where a whole number is requested. SyntaxError? Check quotes, brackets and braces.

Build requirements: code checks update as you type. Run your program to check the results, or select Check build to use the supplied test inputs. Editing code clears old test results. Always read your names and messages to check that their meaning is clear.
